note: Ground-floor articles and possessives room. Determiners have no grammatical gender of their own here (they mark it), so no left/right rule (divider null); the feminine-marking la/une figures are women and the masculine-marking le/un figures are men. The white door on the far left goes back to the counting room; the white door on the right leads to the questions room. Zoom: the teacher's desk at the back.
